decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay, utilizing a mix of land types to take advantage of Tribal Flames and Leyline synergy. The deck features a mix of efficient creatures like Ragavan and Territorial Kavu, backed up by powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial. With Jegantha as a companion, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a steady stream of threats, backed up by Leyline disruption and versatile removal options. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's aggressive strategy while providing the flexibility to adjust to various matchups.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and quick, efficient removal spells. Cards like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge are used to quickly deal with threats on the board, while creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls put pressure on the opponent. The deck also utilizes cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's mana base and slow down their game plan. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and fast-paced, using a combination of creatures and spells to quickly close out games.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and direct damage spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key concept of this deck is to outpace the opponent with fast creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls, while also disrupting their strategy with cards like Static Prison and Blood Moon. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional ramp and consistency to maintain pressure on the opponent. This deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize, utilizing a mix of creatures, burn spells, and disruptive elements for a well-rounded aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures and control the board with spells like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble. The key strategy is to accelerate into large threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Trinisphere. The combination of ramp and control allows the deck to dominate the late game and overwhelm opponents with powerful threats.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive strategies with a mix of creatures and spells to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. The key concept revolves around playing efficient and powerful creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Amped Raptor, supported by burn spells like Lightning Bolt to control the board and deal direct damage. The inclusion of cards like Galvanic Discharge and Static Prison helps disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a fast-paced offensive strategy. The deck also includes a companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, to provide additional resources and versatility in gameplay.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Guide of Souls, supported by disruptive spells like Lightning Bolt and Static Prison. The inclusion of cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ocelot Pride help to boost the aggro strategy, while The One Ring provides additional benefits for combat. The use of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion enhances the deck's overall consistency and efficiency in executing its aggressive game plan.

The main idea of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple, in order to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and Breaker of Creation. The deck also includes control elements like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats while controlling the game with disruptive spells and abilities.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a combo using cards that manipulate mana, counter opponent's spells, and dig through the deck to find key pieces. By utilizing efficient spells like Preordain and Whir of Invention, the deck aims to set up a win condition with cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Tameshi, Reality Architect. The deck also includes disruption elements like Force of Negation and Suppression Ray to protect the combo while controlling the opponent's board. Ultimately, the goal is to win through a powerful combo without relying on traditional lands.

This Mardu Aggro deck utilizes strong creatures like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride to quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck also incorporates disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provides additional aggression and reach. The deck's mana base is streamlined with fetch lands and a mix of shock lands to ensure consistent plays. The companion Jegantha, the Wellspring adds an extra layer of versatility to the deck without sacrificing its aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on using spells to control the opponent's board while setting up for a powerful reanimation combo. By countering threats with cards like Force of Negation and Spell Snare, and removing creatures with Fatal Push and Toxic Deluge, the deck buys time to set up the combo. Tainted Indulgence and Persist allow for graveyard manipulation and reanimating key creatures like Archon of Cruelty. The deck also includes card draw with Consider and utilizes lands like Polluted Delta and Watery Grave for mana fixing. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm and outvalue opponents with powerful reanimated creatures.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to aggressively overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and direct damage spells. By utilizing cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Lightning Bolt to chip away at the opponent's life total, coupled with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to maintain board presence, this deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent has a chance to establish their own game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion also adds an additional layer of versatility to the deck.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, backed up by burn spells like Lightning Bolt. The deck also utilizes powerful anthem effects like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Arena of Glory to pump up its creatures and overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of The One Ring provides a versatile threat, while cards like Static Prison and Blood Moon disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, efficient, and relentless in its pursuit of victory.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on utilizing efficient instant and sorcery spells to control the board and deal damage quickly to the opponent. By using cheap removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, along with card advantage from Mishra's Bauble and Thought Scour, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck aims to end the game as fast as possible through a combination of burn spells and aggressive creatures, while also maintaining card advantage to stay ahead in the game.

This Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and burn spells. It utilizes efficient creatures like Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge to deal damage quickly. Blood Moon can disrupt opponents who rely on non-basic lands, while Goblin Bombardment provides additional reach. The deck also includes some controlling elements like Static Prison to slow down opposing strategies. Overall, the key concept is to apply early pressure and maintain board presence to secure a swift victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays and utilizing the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring for extra value. The deck includes powerful creatures like Amped Raptor and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, as well as burn spells like Lightning Bolt to quickly take down opponents. Cards like Guide of Souls and Static Prison help control the board while cards like Goblin Bombardment provide extra reach. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of efficient creatures, burn spells, and disruptive elements.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the synergy between Underworld Breach, Urza's Saga, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to set up a combo that allows for repeated casting of spells from the graveyard. This strategy aims to generate a high amount of value and card advantage while potentially setting up a win condition with Thassa's Oracle or Malevolent Rumble. The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and graveyard recursion to fuel its combo potential and overwhelm opponents with powerful spells and abilities.
